scenarios.brief: A release team continues the toolkit through real operational changes. Let implementation attempts, observed command results, user corrections, and later handoffs appear in ordinary conversation and affect later work.
scenarios.runtime_conditions: Use the fixed Python standard-library environment. Treat only public observations and corrections as history.

scenarios.brief: A compliance team continues the document workflow through import, normalization, review, correction, and reporting work. Let real failures and user clarifications shape later changes.
scenarios.runtime_conditions: Use the fixed Python standard-library environment. Count an environment difference only after it appears in a public command or test result.

scenarios.brief: A customer continues the planner across related work. Reveal conventions, observed results, and scoped corrections only when a real implementation or later workflow needs them.
scenarios.runtime_conditions: Use the fixed Python standard-library environment. Only public differences, failures, and corrections count as historical evidence.
